profile_text.body:
Allient Inc is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, traded under the ticker ALNT, with SEC CIK 0000046129. Its website, alantra.com, describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. The firm says it provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and describes its ambition as supporting clients with the best advice and products through what it calls an accountable and ethical approach to business. It also describes a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while operating with autonomy and being personally invested in the firm.

No AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company, and no lawsuits are recorded against it. Its law exposure is recorded in New York.
